hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A pmav.fun V2 bonding-curve fair-launch hook (quoted/RWA variant) that runs coin sales directly as a Uniswap v4 pool. Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet-cap with auto-refund waterfall, and a decaying anti-snipe buy premium; on reaching the raise target it automatically graduates the pool to a standard Uniswap v4 position with permanently locked full-range liquidity.
